title: Typed backend services and SQL repositories
summary: Generated Protobuf/Connect TypeScript service and clients with real local protocol tests, plus a generated sqlc Go SQLite repository with transaction and cancellation tests.

profiles: Linux x86_64, Node 24.19.0 / TypeScript 5.9.3, Buf 1.73.0, Connect 2.2.0: proto lint, descriptor generation/typecheck and 2 real local HTTP protocol tests passed.
Linux x86_64, Go 1.27.2 / sqlc 1.31.1 / modernc SQLite 1.39.1: query generation and repository transaction, missing-row and cancellation test passed.
notes: Tested profiles are independent Node and Go runtimes. The injected repository is the integration boundary; the examples do not claim to share process memory.
Generated Protobuf and SQL query code is excluded from delivered files; commands regenerate it using pinned tools. Retain upstream generator/runtime notices.
The browser client source typechecks but no browser/CORS deployment was exercised. Production auth, database lifecycle and trusted breaking-change baselines remain receiving-service gates.
